packageRules.description: Stay on Python <=3.14 for CI images while prometheus.prometheus is pinned to its pre-0.31.0 commit (see requirements.yml). Includes minor bumps because 3.14 -> 3.15 is a minor update. Revisit once the collection is installed from Galaxy 0.31.0+.

Block ansible-core 2.23+: the pinned prometheus.prometheus commit declares requires_ansible <=2.22.99, and 2.23 disables the embedded templates that 0.30.x still uses. Revisit once the collection is installed from Galaxy 0.31.0+.
